title: Kitchen Splashback quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a custom glass kitchen splashback for the Smith Residence in Bondi, NSW. Comprising three (3) panels of 6mm Starphire Toughened Glass, colour-backed in Dulux 'Grey Pail'. Panel dimensions: One (1) at 900mm wide x 750mm high (behind cooktop), one (1) at 600mm wide x 750mm high (next to cooktop), and one (1) at 1200mm wide x 750mm high (next to sink). Includes one (1) standard double powerpoint cutout and one (1) standard single powerpoint cutout. All visible edges to be polished. Installation with clear silicone adhesive, including site clean-up and protective packaging.
workingDetail: Toughened glass panels (6mm), Colour backing (painted or vinyl), Silicone adhesive, Powerpoint and switch cutouts
